## Import this exact API from src/lib (do not invent different names)

From "../lib/csv" or "../../lib/csv" depending on file location:

export type CsvSheet = { headers: string[]; rows: string[][] };
export type MissingCell = { row: number; col: number };
export type DuplicateGroup = { key: string; indexes: number[]; label: string };
export type Analysis = {
  duplicateRowIndexes: number[];
  duplicateGroups: DuplicateGroup[];
  missingCells: MissingCell[];
  rowsWithMissing: number[];
  missingByColumn: { header: string; index: number; count: number }[];
};
export function parseCsv(text: string): CsvSheet;
export function analyze(sheet: CsvSheet): Analysis;
export function applyClean(rows: string[][], width: number, mode: "all" | "duplicates" | "incomplete"): { rows: string[][]; removedDuplicates: number; removedIncomplete: number };
export function toCsv(headers: string[], rows: string[][]): string;
export function downloadCsv(filename: string, csv: string): void;
export function cleanDownloadName(name: string): string;

From sample module:
export const SAMPLE_NAME = "harbor-orders.csv";
export const SAMPLE_CSV: string;

If those files are not on disk yet, still write the UI against this contract. They will appear.

## Product behavior (all of this must work)

State holds the loaded sheet:
- name: string
- headers: string[]
- original: string[][]  (never mutated)
- rows: string[][]       (working copy)

1. Pop-up bars, fixed along the bottom of the viewport: two controls, "Upload" and "Preview". Clicking one opens that bar as a sheet that slides up above the dock. Only one bar open at a time. Opening one closes the other. Close via the bar's close control, Escape, and a click on the dimmed backdrop. aria-expanded on the toggles. Focus moves to the opened bar's heading or close button.

2. Initial state: no sheet loaded, Upload bar open.

3. Upload bar:
   - Drag and drop a file onto a drop zone, plus a real file input button labeled so a screen reader understands it ("Choose CSV").
   - Accept files; read as text; parseCsv. On throw, show the error message in the bar and do not replace the current sheet.
   - "Load sample" reads SAMPLE_CSV / SAMPLE_NAME through the same success path as an upload.
   - On success: store name, headers, original and rows as a copy of parsed rows, clear the error, set a polite status, and open the Preview bar.

4. Preview bar:
   - Disabled or a clear empty message when nothing is loaded ("Load a CSV to preview it.").
   - When loaded: filename, row count, column count.
   - A table with a caption, sticky header, row numbers (1-based), horizontal scroll. Monospace cells.
   - Highlight extra duplicate rows (indexes in analysis.duplicateRowIndexes) with a distinct wash and a row label "Duplicate".
   - Highlight missing cells (trim empty, matching analysis.missingCells) with a coral mark. If the cell is empty or whitespace, show the word "blank" as the visible text, not an empty box.
   - Filter chips: All | Issues. Issues shows only rows that are duplicate copies OR have a missing value. If a filter hides everything, say so.
   - For large files, render at most 250 rows and say that preview is truncated and download still includes every row. Provide "Show more" that raises the cap by 250 if under 2000 rows; above that, stay capped and explain.
   - Footer actions also available here: Clean sheet, Download CSV.

5. Main workspace (visible behind/above the bars, not only inside them):
   - Wordmark: Clean sheet. "sheet" in Fraunces italic. Eyebrow "CSV desk". One plain sentence: "Upload a spreadsheet, see duplicate rows and blank cells, then download a version with those rows removed."
   - Empty state when no file: invite the person to load the sample or open Upload. The empty state can also call the same load-sample and open-upload actions.
   - When loaded, stat cards: Rows (current), Duplicate rows (analysis.duplicateRowIndexes.length), Blank cells (analysis.missingCells.length), After clean (length after applyClean(rows, headers.length, "all") — compute for display, do not mutate until the user clicks).
   - A short definition line: "A duplicate matches another row in every column. A blank cell is empty."
   - Column list from missingByColumn: name and count of blanks, with a proportional bar. Hide columns only if there are none.
   - Up to 5 duplicate groups by label and how many copies (indexes.length). If more, "and N more".
   - Buttons:
     - Remove duplicates — applyClean(..., "duplicates"). Disabled when duplicateRowIndexes.length === 0.
     - Remove incomplete rows — applyClean(..., "incomplete"). Disabled when rowsWithMissing.length === 0.
     - Clean sheet — applyClean(..., "all"). Primary. Disabled when both issue counts are 0.
     - Restore original — set rows back to a copy of original. Disabled when rows already match original (compare lengths and cell values).
     - Download CSV — toCsv + downloadCsv(cleanDownloadName(name), csv). Disabled when no sheet.
   - After a clean or restore, set a polite aria-live status. Examples: "Removed 5 incomplete rows and 3 duplicates. 12 rows remain." Omit a clause when that count is 0. Restore: "Restored the original sheet."
   - Cleaning always uses the full working set, not the filtered preview. Say that near the preview footer in one short line.

6. Do not drop rows except through those buttons. Do not treat "0" as missing. The engine already defines missing and duplicates — trust analyze().

## Visual design (follow this, do not substitute a generic purple-gradient dashboard)

Signature: a dark desk, and the preview bar is a warm paper sheet sliding up out of it.

Tokens:
- Desk background #101114
- Housing panels #1A1C21
- Hairline on dark: rgba(244, 237, 226, 0.1)
- Text on dark #F4EDE2
- Muted on dark #B7B1A6 (must stay readable)
- Brass accent #E6B15A — primary buttons and the small lamp highlight only
- Paper surface #F3EFE4
- Paper ink #1C1B19
- Paper rules #E2D9C8
- Duplicate row wash on paper #F8E7C4
- Missing cell on paper: background #F8D2C8, text #8C2F1B

Type: Outfit for UI, Fraunces only for the word "sheet" in the title, IBM Plex Mono for stats, row numbers, and table cells. These fonts are loaded in index.html by the other agent; still set the font-family stacks with those names and a reasonable fallback.

Layout: page padding that works from 360px wide to a desktop max around 1120px. Stats as a responsive grid. Bottom dock inset from the screen edges so it doesn't collide with the home indicator. The open bar max-height about 68vh, internally scrollable, width aligned with the page. Paper panel has a slight shadow and a 1px warm edge. Dark panels are quiet.

Motion: bars slide up in ~280ms with a smooth ease. Respect prefers-reduced-motion (no slide, just appear). Visible :focus-visible outlines in brass on dark and a dark outline on paper. Buttons min-height 44px. color-scheme: dark on the page.

Copy: sentence case, plain verbs, no marketing filler, no exclamation points. Controls say exactly what they do.

Empty, error, and success states all exist. The upload error sits in the upload bar in the issue color, readable on the dark panel (use #F0B0A2 or similar, not tiny gray).

Write complete, polished CSS in src/index.css using variables. No inline style soup. Keep components readable.

Return: the component file list, how the bars behave, and anything you had to assume because src/lib was not present yet.
